resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Danish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Danish pass identified 25 actionable defects in electrical, thermal, circuit, and unit terminology; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Danish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The current example title used an adjective instead of the Danish noun for current.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Find aktuelle’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Find strømmen’.

findings.summary: Electrical power was translated as electrical current.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Elektrisk strøm’ although the section describes power P.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Elektrisk effekt’.

findings.summary: The series and parallel instruction used an awkward comma construction.
evidence: The previous text said ‘For serie- og parallelle netværk, brug’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it for Danish series and parallel circuits.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating summary said that current transforms resistance into heat.
evidence: Resistance is not the energy being transformed; electrical energy is.
findings.resolution: Changed the summary to electrical energy being converted to heat by current.

findings.summary: The heating-power title used an unnatural literal term.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Varmekraft’, which suggests force rather than power.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Varmeeffekt’.

findings.summary: The paragraph called electrical energy a rate of transfer.
evidence: The source distinguishes electrical power as a rate, not energy itself.
findings.resolution: Corrected the term to electrical power and retained the thermal explanation.

findings.summary: The practical check repeated current where the source requires current and power.
evidence: The previous text said ‘den forventede strøm og strøm’.
findings.resolution: Changed the pair to the expected current and power.

findings.summary: Conservation was translated with a false cognate.
evidence: The previous description used ‘konservering’ rather than Danish ‘bevarelse’.
findings.resolution: Changed the wording to conservation at circuit nodes and loops.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms title was an unnatural literal translation.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Kredsvilkår’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Kredsløbsbegreber’.

findings.summary: The introductory circuit sentence used an unnatural Danish idiom.
evidence: The previous text said a diagram was easier ‘at ræsonnere om’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to say the concepts make a diagram easier to understand.

findings.summary: The current-law title used ‘nuværende’, meaning present or current in time.
evidence: Kirchhoff's current law requires the electrical-current term ‘strøm’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Kirchhoffs strømlov’.

findings.summary: The current-law paragraph used ‘aktuelle’ for current directions.
evidence: The previous wording was ‘Vælg aktuelle retninger’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to specify the directions of current.

findings.summary: The series-resistor title separated the compound noun incorrectly.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Serie modstande’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Seriemodstande’.

findings.summary: The voltage-law paragraph used an ungrammatical description of voltage rises and falls.
evidence: The previous wording said ‘summen af spændingen stiger og falder’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as the algebraic sum of voltage rises and drops.

findings.summary: The cells title had incorrect plural agreement.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Celler i serie og parallelle’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Celler i serie og parallel’.

findings.summary: The current-sharing bullet repeated the word for contacts and omitted switches.
evidence: The previous text ended with ‘kontakter, ledninger og kontakter’.
findings.resolution: Changed the final item to switches.

findings.summary: The right-triangle title used an incorrect Danish adjective.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Retrette trekanter’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Retvinklede trekanter’.

findings.summary: The cosine formula used the wrong grammatical form for hypotenuse.
evidence: The previous formula used ‘hypotenuse’ rather than ‘hypotenusen’.
findings.resolution: Changed the formula label to the definite Danish form.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity formula omitted the temperature-difference symbol.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘C = Q/AT’ rather than C = Q / ΔT.
findings.resolution: Restored the canonical heat-capacity relationship.

findings.summary: The heat-flux title was a direct English loan where Danish technical wording is clearer.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Varmeflux’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Varmestrømstæthed’.

findings.summary: The heat-flux check used an infinitive instead of an imperative.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘Skelne’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the imperative ‘Skeln’.

findings.summary: The final heat-flux check used an infinitive and a missing object.
evidence: The previous bullet ended with ‘bruge varmekapacitet til temperaturændring’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as using heat capacity for temperature changes.

findings.summary: The SI table mistranslated mass as ‘messe’.
evidence: The previous Danish row used ‘messe’ instead of ‘masse’.
findings.resolution: Corrected the mass quantity label.

findings.summary: The SI table mistranslated amount of substance as ‘muldvarp’.
evidence: ‘Muldvarp’ means mole as an animal, not amount of substance.
findings.resolution: Changed the row to ‘Stofmængde’.

findings.summary: One unit-check bullet remained in English.
evidence: The previous bullet was ‘Convert before multiplying or dividing.’
findings.resolution: Translated it as ‘Konvertér enheder, før du ganger eller dividerer.’
